description: Scan, then write the current capability definitions into toolprint.lock as the trusted baseline for future scans. Pinning accepts drift, so only call this after the user reviews the changes; poisoning and leaked-secret findings still set `failing: true`. The user should commit the lockfile after a pin.

allClients.description: Discover and scan the MCP config of every agent client installed on this machine (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed, and more).

baseline.description: Path to a prior JSON report, to show findings new or resolved since then.

clients.description: Scan only these agent client ids, for example `cursor` or `zed`.

config.description: Path to an MCP client config file (Claude Desktop / VS Code / Cursor).

failOn.description: Minimum severity that counts as failing: info, low, medium, high, or critical. Default high.

failOnNew.description: With `baseline`, count only newly introduced findings as failing.

ignoreFile.description: Path to toolprint.ignore.json with reviewed false positives.

probe.description: Call tools the server annotates as read-only (a self-report, not verified) with empty arguments and inspect what they return. Off by default; only probe servers the user trusts to execute.

probeTools.description: Call these tools by name regardless of annotation. Enables probing on its own.

skills.description: Scan SKILL.md skill bundles on disk instead of MCP servers: `true` for the default skill roots, or a directory path.

target.description: What to scan: an MCP config path, an http(s) MCP URL, an `npx:<package>` spec, or a raw server command. Omit to auto-discover the project's MCP config.

workingDirectory.description: Project directory for relative paths and lockfile discovery. Default: this process's working directory.

name: pin
title: Pin current definitions into toolprint.lock
